thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT 1856004321 — GPU pool us-west-2-prod queue depth spiked >1200. Autoscaler reporting scale failures. Severity: P2. Paging oncall now.
Ash (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Looking at autoscaler logs and pool metrics.
Maya S: I'm seeing a sharp ramp in long-running chat sessions + a bunch of offline batch jobs re-queued. Queue growth started ~10m ago.
Ravi K: autoscaler logs: `scaleUp failed: reachedScaleLimit (limit=40, desired=44)` — upstream controller rejecting new nodes. Also `backoff: true` in controller.
Jo: @Ash can we divert some low-priority traffic or move non-prod work out?
Ash (oncall): Starting mitigation plan: 1) identify noncritical workloads to throttle 2) enable burst pool if available 3) add temporary route to us-east as fallback. Will update.
Maya S: Support bot shows increased 5xxs in our public telemetry: embedding requests timeouts and some streaming sessions cut at token 256.
support-bot: Customers with elevated errors: ["AcmeApp", "FinFlow", "SigmaSearch"] — elevated error rate > 5x baseline. Ticket cluster created: INC-4558.
Chris L: Can we increase scaleLimit from 40 -> 50 as emergency? Ops will require a blue-green rollout of pool config.
Ravi K: We attempted config update earlier but hit quota checks in control plane. I'll try a manual override on the control plane (requires 2fa).
Ash (oncall): Rolling a fast config bump to scaleLimit=48. If it fails, fallback is draining low-priority queues and diverting to us-east.
Maya S: Observed autoscaler backoff: sequence: fail->5m backoff->retry->fail. That explains queue piling.
Ash (oncall): Ran command:
```
# internal CLI
redwood pools update us-west-2-prod --scale-limit 48 --reason "incident 1856004321 emergency"
# response
Updating pool... accepted, pending validation
```
Ash (oncall): Control plane validation is slow — looks like our validation job got queued behind config sync.
Jo: Starting job prune for non-critical batch queues (tag: low-priority).
Chris L: Running `prune` now — sample command and output:
```
> redwood queue prune --pool us-west-2-prod --tag low-priority --max 200
Pruned 183 jobs, reclaimed ~42 GPUs worth of KV slots
```
Maya S: Nice. I'm seeing CPU/GPU utilization drop on some nodes. Queue growth rate dropped from +80/s to +20/s.
Ash (oncall): Control plane finally accepted the scaleLimit update and autoscaler attempted scale-up. New desired = 46.
Ravi K: Autoscaler still showing some 403s calling cloud provider API for quota. Sharding attempt to other nodegroups in us-west-2 is failing.
Jo: Can we spin a temporary burst pool in us-east? What's the cross-region cold-start time?
Chris L: Cold-start ~90–120s for new GPU instance; cache-warm ~30s for tokenizer KV. We'll lose a handful of in-flight requests, but should relieve queue within ~5m.
Ash (oncall): Kicking off cross-region fallback. Creating deployment: `redwood pools create us-east-burst --type burst --size 12`
Maya S: Pushing routing rule to send new requests to us-east-burst for customers with non-sensitive data. Will keep sensitive workloads in us-west-2.
support-bot: Notifying customers in INC-4558 about partial degradation and mitigation steps (template used: /incidents/partials-degradation-v2).
Maya S: Customer comms sent to affected customers (AcmeApp, FinFlow, SigmaSearch) — we said: "partial degradation, working on increasing capacity, ETA 30-45m".
Ravi K: Cloud quotas team responded: temporary quota increase approved for 2 hours. This should let us scale to desired nodes.
Ash (oncall): Autoscaler now reports desired=52, actual=50 (2 pending provisioning). Queue rate is flattening.
Maya S: Error rate dropping, embedding timeouts reduced. Monitoring shows rolling recovery across lanes. :white_check_mark:
Ash (oncall): Handoff time — handing off to @Maya S for mitigation completion and post-incident follow-up. My shift ends in 20m.
Maya S: Ack — taking over. Current state: pool at 50/52, queue depth ~180, error rate back to ~1.2x baseline. Continuing monitoring and will run postmortem after stabilization.
Jo: Temporary action items I executed: pruned low-priority jobs, toggled routing for non-sensitive requests to us-east-burst.
Chris L: Ops action: increase default pool scaleLimit in us-west-2 from 40 -> 60 across all prod pools, with canary to one pool first. Filing infra change request CHG-789.
Ravi K: Follow-ups: add autoscaler alert for "repeated scaleUp failures with backoff > 3 cycles"; improve control plane config validation throughput.
Maya S: Postmortem owners: Maya S (lead), Ravi K (autoscaler fixes), Jo (queue-priority policy), Chris L (infra quotas/scale limits), Ash (incident commander handoff notes). Target publish in 72h.
support-bot: Created customer follow-up tickets and added status page update draft.
Maya S: Adding immediate mitigation playbook note: if queue > 1000 and scaleUp errors seen -> auto-prune low-priority queues + spawn burst pool in fallback region automatically.
Ash (oncall): One more datapoint: the initial root cause seems to be sudden load from a partner integration + a backlog replay from scheduled jobs. Will validate with logs.
Maya S: Closing incident channel once stable and documenting timeline. Current plan: continue monitoring 1h, then capture metrics and start postmortem.
Chris L: Thanks team. Great quick mitigation. We'll refine the autoscaler guardrails and the control plane validation path.
Maya S: marking action items in the incident tracker: INC-4558-PI1..PI5. Will assign owners and due dates.
Ash (oncall): Leaving final note: handoff completed, thanks everybody. :rocket:
